about.title: About That 1 Painter North Houston
text: From The Woodlands master-planned homes and Kingwood "Livable Forest" custom builds to Tomball historic downtown, Magnolia horse-country ranches, and Conroe lakefront homes on Lake Conroe, our North Houston crew handles the full painting scope: interior, exterior, cabinets, decks, fences, and specialty finishes. Every project is built around Piney Woods realities: Gulf Coast hurricane exposure, extreme humidity, heavy rainfall, mildew load, triple-digit summer heat, and February freeze-thaw cracking (Winter Storm Uri).

That 1 Painter North Houston is owned and operated by Cody Foster and Jesse Ortega, serving Tomball, The Woodlands, Spring, Conroe, and Kingwood with local crews and a 3-year written warranty. As Houston natives, we bring hometown accountability to every project and treat your home like our own. Our services cover interior painting, exterior painting, cabinet refinishing, and specialty finishes across the North Houston metro.

Your painting project means as much to us as it does to you. We're licensed and insured, and our promise is simple: we'll be your best house guests, treating your place with the utmost care and leaving it even more pristine than when we arrived.
